reason: Original task prereg requires at least GRU-class recurrent capacity. Add independently trained GRU16 as stronger comparator; never weaken existing RNN16/symbolic controls and never select using original heldout outcomes.
architecture: Input six signed visible bits plus four one-hot action bits. Hidden reset to zero per four-step episode. GRU16 with update/reset/candidate gates and a six-logit next-visible readout. 1398 trained floating scalars. No oracle or hidden latch input.
train_source: identical 24 four-step passive episodes plus eight four-step active episodes to all strong controls; teacher forcing for source-only training
optimizer: Full-batch BPTT, Adam lr .01 beta1 .9 beta2 .999 epsilon 1e-8, L2 weight decay .0001 on matrices, gradient norm clipping 5, binary cross entropy averaged over six bits and all source steps; no early stopping, no hidden-accuracy tuning
initialization: NumPy PCG64 per seed Gaussian N(0,.1) all matrices, biases zero, float64
freeze: All three seeds always train 1800 epochs and return source-fit; select strongest only by source train loss (then train accuracy, then lowest seed). Unqualified if best source fit under 95% or divergence.
diagnostics: On fixture IDs 0..7 only, tests may call <=24 epochs and source-blind finite-difference gradient checks. No DEV results permit original-world source/answers or threshold changes.
comparison: GRU16 joins and dominates qualification requirement when stronger than RNN16, memoryless, or symbolic controls; direct-weight future mechanism cannot claim superiority unless it exceeds all qualified strong controls on fresh first-use after separate prereg. Always report whole-process cost.
